thread:
emma: Hey team — Customer (Acme) reported increased p99 latency and occasional 503s. They say traffic for us-east-prod is being routed to eu-west and back, adding ~250-400ms. Can someone look?

support-bot: Alert: RouteAnomalyDetector detected 12 cross-region serve events for customer-acme in the last 3m. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/route-anom/ACME-1234 :rotating_light:

sanjay: I can take this. Any idea when it started?
olivia: They opened a support ticket ~20m ago. Ticket shows spikes at 20:12 and 20:18 UTC with concurrent hedged requests from their SDK.
emma: Access logs from our edge show origin_region=eu-west for requests that should target us-east-prod pool. Some client IPs are US.
ryan: Can you paste the client's SDK config / logs? Hedging + aggressive RTT-based fallback could cause region flip-flop.
emma: Pasting excerpt from customer logs (sanitized):
```
[20:10:52] client: sending hedged request: primary=us-east, hedge=eu-west, timeout=150ms
[20:10:53] client: primary timed out, hedge responded -> accepted eu-west
[20:12:05] client: local RTT probe showed eu-west faster, switching preferred region
[20:12:28] client: server returned 503 from eu-west during load spike
```

sanjay: That matches a hedged-retry pattern. Their SDK default hedging_timeout is low (150ms) -> often triggers hedges that race cross-region. When hedges choose the faster backend, subsequent routing preferences flip.
olivia: Do we have evidence of our routing policy switching they rely on?
ryan: Yes — the customer is using our client-side region preference cookie (region_hint) but the SDK resets it when hedged responses come back faster. The SDK also retries with exponential backoff but small cap so repeated short timeouts cause oscillation.
emma: Customer's repro steps from ticket: 1) Bulk send 1000 parallel short requests 2) SDK hedging enabled 3) Observe ~15% served from eu-west and 3% 503s.
sanjay: Quick mitigation: ask customer to set region_affinity:true and disable hedging OR increase hedging_timeout to something closer to expected median RTT to avoid cross-region races. Example config: 
```
{ "region_affinity": true, "hedging": { "enabled": false }, "retries": { "max_attempts": 3, "base_backoff_ms": 200 } }
```
olivia: Can we also add server-side guard to avoid marking eu-west as preferred for their tenant after a single hedged success? Maybe require N consistent successes before updating preference.
ryan: We already have a smoothing window but it's per-route and short (30s). For tenants with heavy parallelism that's too reactive. I'll open a follow-up infra ticket to increase smoothing for hedging-detected preference flips and make it configurable per-tenant.
emma: For immediate customer-facing fix, suggest they disable hedging and use pinned_region = us-east. Also advise spacing requests or increasing base_backoff.
sanjay: I'll draft a short reply with repro-safe instructions and an explanation of server routing behavior.
sanjay: Reply draft: "Thanks — we're seeing client-side hedging causing region preference oscillation. Please disable hedging or increase hedging timeout and enable region_affinity/pinned_region while we harden smoothing on our side. If you can share a small repro we can test changes from our infra. Also include SDK version. "

support-bot: Ticket #ACME-571 updated: customer provided SDK version 1.4.2 and a small repro harness (link attached).
emma: 1.4.2 has hedging enabled by default. Recommend upgrade to 1.4.4 which includes a safer hedging-timeout default (PR merged yesterday).
olivia: Customer asked why they saw 503s when eu-west was "faster". Answer: hedged requests can land on a backend under transient load; if that backend is running low on capacity, it may return 5xx under overload. Racing increases chance of hitting an overloaded replica.
ryan: Action items: 1) Support reply with config + upgrade suggestion (sanjay). 2) Ops ticket to adjust smoothing window per-tenant (ryan). 3) Docs note for SDK hedging defaults and guidance (olivia). 4) Monitor ACME telemetry for next 2 hours (emma).
sanjay: Sent reply to customer with config snippet and upgrade link. Noted temporary mitigation steps.
emma: Customer confirmed they toggled hedging off and pinned region -> latency normalized within 3m, 503s dropped.
ryan: I'll proceed with infra ticket: INFRA-2041 (adjust region preference smoothing for hedged signals).
olivia: I'll update docs and add a short FAQ about hedged retries causing region hopping.
sanjay: Thanks all. If ACME still wants hedging we can work on a safer rollout (rate-limited hedging, region-aware hedges).
emma: Closing thread after 2h of monitoring if no regression. :white_check_mark:
